chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Mansur Buzurj, from Mufazzal who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Beware of the lowliness, for indeed, the Shia of Ali are those whose belly and private part are chaste, whose striving is intense, who act for their Creator, who hope for His reward, and who fear His punishment. So when you see those, then those are the Shia of Ja'far.

key_terms.عَفَّ بَطْنُهُ وَ فَرْجُهُ: chaste of his belly and private part

ai.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of a true Shia according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes the true 'Shi'a of Ali' by emphasizing moral purity (chastity of belly and private part) and spiritual vigilance (hope and fear) over mere nominal affiliation. This definition aligns with the Shia concept of 'Taqwa' as the primary marker of authenticity, linking the follower's character directly to the Imam's legacy. The mention of 'intense jihad' refers to the internal struggle against the self (Jihad al-Nafs), a key theme in Shia asceticism and gnosis.
